subject_terms: bachelor of science in information technology
bachelor of science in information technology

en: The Bachelor of Science in Information Technology program includes the study of the utilization of both hardware and software technologies involving planning, installing, customizing, operating, managing and administering, and maintaining information technology infrastructure that provides computing solutions to address the needs of an organization.
The program prepares graduates to address various user needs involving the selection, development, application, integration and management of computing technologies within an organization.
ceb: Ang Bachelor of Science in Information Technology nga programa naglakip sa pagtuon sa paggamit sa hardware ug software nga teknolohiya, sama sa pagplano, pag-install, pag-customize, pag-operate, pag-manage, ug pag-maintain sa IT infrastructure nga naghatag og solusyon para sa panginahanglan sa usa ka organisasyon.

Ang programa nag-andam sa mga graduates aron matubag ang lain-laing panginahanglan sa users, sama sa pagpili, pag-develop, paggamit, pag-integrate, ug pag-manage sa computing technologies sulod sa organisasyon.

en: Yes BukSU offers a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology under the College of Technologies focusing on software development network management and modern computing solutions.
ceb: Oo ang BukSU nagtanyag og Bachelor of Science in Information Technology ubos sa College of Technologies nga nagtutok sa software development network management ug modernong computing solutions.

subject_terms: bachelor of science in food technology
bachelor of science in food technology

en: Bachelor of Science in Food Technology is a four-year degree program design to develop professionals in food technology. The program focuses on a mix of pure and applied science, engineering, business, and entrepreneurial skills. It aims to produce professionals who have the capacity to apply the science and technology and related fields of study in post-harvest handling, preparation, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, and marketing of food to ensure food and nutrition security, quality, environmental sustainability and the well-being of individuals, families and communities. The program also aims to promote continued excellence in food science education.
ceb: Ang Bachelor of Science in Food Technology usa ka upat ka tuig nga degree program nga gidisenyo aron mag-develop og mga propesyonal sa food technology. Ang programa nagpunting sa kombinasyon sa pure ug applied science, engineering, business, ug entrepreneurial skills. Tumong niini ang pag-produce og mga propesyonal nga adunay kapasidad sa paggamit sa siyensya ug teknolohiya ug uban pang may kalabotan nga larangan sa post-harvest handling, preparation, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, ug marketing sa pagkaon aron masiguro ang food ug nutrition security, kalidad, environmental sustainability, ug kaayohan sa mga indibidwal, pamilya, ug komunidad. Ang programa usab nagtumong sa pagpalambo sa padayon nga kahusayan sa food science education.

en: Yes, BukSU offers a Bachelor of Science in Food Technology focusing on food science, post-harvest handling, packaging, and ensuring food quality and security.
ceb: Oo, nagtanyag ang BukSU og Bachelor of Science in Food Technology nga nagpunting sa food science, post-harvest handling, packaging, ug pag-siguro sa food quality ug security.

subject_terms: bachelor of science in electronics technology
bachelor of science in electronics technology

en: The Bachelor of Science and Electronics Technology program offers opportunities for students to learn and apply the scientific knowledge and methods in modern technology to support electronics technology activities in the field of industrial technology. Students are provided a focus on classroom instruction and hands-on laboratory and testing experiences. Moreover, the program prepares the students to become professionals, and be qualified for the positions in the field of electronics technology such as electronic systems analysis and design, technical sales and the service, and engineering operations and maintenance.
ceb: Ang Bachelor of Science in Electronics Technology nga programa naghatag og oportunidad sa mga estudyante nga makat-on ug magamit ang siyentipikong kahibalo ug mga pamaagi sa modernong teknolohiya aron suportahan ang mga kalihokan sa electronics technology sa larangan sa industrial technology. Ang mga estudyante gihatagan og pagtagad sa classroom instruction ug hands-on nga laboratory ug testing experiences. Dugang pa, ang programa nag-andam sa mga estudyante aron mahimong propesyonal ug kwalipikado para sa mga posisyon sa larangan sa electronics technology sama sa electronic systems analysis ug design, technical sales ug service, ug engineering operations ug maintenance.

en: Yes, BukSU offers a Bachelor of Science in Electronics Technology which focuses on the technical aspects of electronic systems, circuitry, and modern technological infrastructure.
ceb: Oo, nagtanyag ang BukSU og Bachelor of Science in Electronics Technology nga nagpunting sa technical aspects sa electronic systems, circuitry, ug modern technological infrastructure.

subject_terms: bachelor of science in entertainment and multimedia computing

en: The Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing is the study and use of concepts, principles, and techniques of computing in the design and development of multimedia products and solutions. It includes various applications such as in science, entertainment, education, simulations and advertising.

The program enables the students to be knowledgeable of the whole pipeline of Digital Animation projects. The students will acquire the independence and creative competencies to articulate project design and requirements of new projects, not necessarily based on standard templates.

The Digital Animation Technology major is the study and application of fundamental and advanced theories and techniques in 2D and 3D animation, use and development for advancement of animation technologies and production of commercially acceptable content and viable solutions for different platforms such as broadcast, web and mobile cast.
ceb: Ang Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing mao ang pagtuon ug paggamit sa mga konsepto, prinsipyo, ug teknik sa computing sa pagdesinyo ug pag-develop sa multimedia products ug solutions. Naglakip kini og lain-laing aplikasyon sama sa science, entertainment, education, simulations, ug advertising.

Ang programa naghatag sa estudyante og kahibalo sa tibuok proseso sa Digital Animation projects. Ang mga estudyante makabaton og independence ug creative competencies aron ma-articulate ang project design ug requirements sa bag-ong proyekto, dili lang base sa standard templates.

Ang Digital Animation Technology major mao ang pagtuon ug aplikasyon sa fundamental ug advanced nga teorya ug teknik sa 2D ug 3D animation, paggamit ug pag-develop alang sa pag-uswag sa animation technologies ug paghimo sa commercially acceptable content ug viable solutions para sa lain-laing platforms sama sa broadcast, web, ug mobile cast.

en: Yes, BukSU offers a Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing major in Digital Animation Technology, focusing on digital arts, 2D/3D animation, and multimedia production.
ceb: Oo, nagtanyag ang BukSU og Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing major in Digital Animation Technology, nga nagpunting sa digital arts, 2D/3D animation, ug multimedia production.

en: The Bachelor of Science in Biology major in Biotechnology is a four-year program focusing on biological sciences with an emphasis on biotechnology applications.
It prepares students for research, laboratory work, and technology-driven biological fields by exploring the intersection of living organisms and industrial processes.
ceb: Ang Bachelor of Science in Biology major in Biotechnology usa ka upat ka tuig nga programa nga nagpunting sa biological sciences nga adunay gibug-aton sa biotechnology applications.
Nag-andam kini sa mga estudyante alang sa research, laboratory work, ug technology-driven biological fields pinaagi sa pag-eksplorar sa interseksyon sa buhing organismo ug industrial processes.

en: Yes, BukSU offers a Bachelor of Science in Biology major in Biotechnology which focuses on biological sciences and biotechnology applications in research and industrial processes.
ceb: Oo, nagtanyag ang BukSU og Bachelor of Science in Biology major in Biotechnology nga nagpunting sa biological sciences ug biotechnology applications sa research ug industrial processes.

subject_terms: bachelor of arts in social science

ceb: Oo, nagtanyag ang BukSU og Bachelor of Arts in Social Science nga nagpunting sa pagtuon sa human society, social relationships, ug community engagement.

en: In the context of Bukidnon State University (BukSU) and the Philippine education system, non-board courses are degree programs that do not require a graduate to pass a national licensure examination (commonly known as a Board Exam) to legally practice their profession.

While Board Courses (like Nursing, Teacher Education, or Accountancy) require passing an exam conducted by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), graduates of non-board programs are considered profession-ready upon receiving their college diploma.
ceb: Sa konteksto sa Bukidnon State University (BukSU) ug sa sistema sa edukasyon sa Pilipinas, ang non-board courses mao ang mga degree program nga dili na kinahanglan nga makapasar ang usa ka graduate sa national licensure examination (kasagarang gitawag og Board Exam) aron legal nga makapraktis sa ilang propesyon.

Samtang ang Board Courses (sama sa Nursing, Teacher Education, o Accountancy) nagkinahanglan nga makapasar sa exam nga gipahigayon sa Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), ang mga graduate sa non-board programs giisip nga andam na sa propesyon pagkadawat nila sa ilang college diploma.

en: At Bukidnon State University (BukSU), board courses are degree programs that require graduates to pass a national licensure examination before they can legally practice their profession. These exams are regulated by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) or other government bodies.
Unlike non-board courses, completing the degree is only the first step; the Board Exam serves as the final gateway to becoming a registered professional.
ceb: Sa Bukidnon State University (BukSU), ang board courses mao ang mga degree program nga nagkinahanglan nga makapasar ang mga graduate sa national licensure examination sa dili pa sila legal nga makapraktis sa ilang propesyon. Kini nga mga exam ginadumala sa Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) o uban pang ahensya sa gobyerno.
Kalahi sa non-board courses, ang paghuman sa degree mao pa lang ang unang lakang; ang Board Exam maoy katapusang agianan aron mahimong rehistradong propesyonal.

en: Yes BukSU offers evening programs specifically for working individuals particularly in the Graduate School including Masters and Doctorate degrees and in the College of Law.
Some undergraduate programs may also offer late afternoon or evening schedules depending on the department.
ceb: Oo ang BukSU nagtanyag og mga klase sa gabii para sa mga nagtrabaho ilabina sa Graduate School sama sa Masters ug Doctorate ug sa College of Law.
Ang uban nga undergraduate programs mahimo usab adunay klase sa hapon o gabii depende sa departamento.

en: The National Service Training Program (NSTP) (R.A. 9163) aims to enhance civic consciousness and defense preparedness in youth by developing ethics of service and patriotism. It mandates training to promote national development, encourage youth involvement in public affairs, and cultivate a pro-God, pro-people, pro-country, and pro-environment
NSTP Components:
ROTC (Reserve Officers' Training Corps)
CWTS (Civic Welfare Training Service)
LTS (Literacy Training Service)
ceb: Ang National Service Training Program (NSTP) (R.A. 9163) nagtumong sa pagpalambo sa civic consciousness ug depensa preparedness sa mga batan-on pinaagi sa pagpalambo sa ethics of service ug patriotism. Kini nagmando sa pagbansay aron mapalambo ang nasudnong kalamboan, pag-awhag sa pag-apil sa mga batan-on sa mga kalihokan sa publiko, ug pagpalambo sa usa ka pro-God, pro-people, pro-country, ug pro-environment
NSTP Components:
ROTC (Reserve Officers' Training Corps)
CWTS (Civic Welfare Training Service)
LTS (Literacy Training Service)

en: Yes, Physical Education is part of BukSU's general curriculum.

Physical Education (PE) at Bukidnon State University (BukSU) functions as a crucial component for holistic student development, focusing on enhancing physical fitness, promoting active lifestyles, and fostering cultural preservation through sports and indigenous games. It emphasizes skill development, teamwork, and mental well-being in university academic life.
ceb: Oo, apil ang Physical Education (PE) sa general curriculum sa BukSU.

Ang Physical Education (PE) sa Bukidnon State University (BukSU) nagsilbing importante nga bahin sa holistic student development, nga nagtutok sa pagpalambo sa physical fitness, pag-promote sa active lifestyles, ug pagpreserbar sa kultura pinaagi sa sports ug indigenous games. Naghatag kini og emphasis sa skill development, teamwork, ug mental well-being sa kinabuhi sa unibersidad.

en: A minor subject supports your major field of study and helps build general knowledge.
ceb: Ang minor subject kay support sa imong major ug naghatag ug dugang kahibalo.

en: Prerequisite subjects are foundational courses that must be completed before enrolling in more advanced or specialized classes.
Their main purpose is to ensure that students have the necessary knowledge, skills, and preparation to succeed in higher-level courses.
ceb: Ang prerequisite subjects mao ang mga batakang kurso nga kinahanglan una mahuman sa estudyante sa dili pa maka-enroll sa mas advanced o specialized nga mga klase.
Ang ilang tumong mao ang pagsiguro nga ang estudyante adunay igo nga kahibalo, kahanas, ug kahanduraw aron magmalampuson sa mas taas nga lebel sa kurso.

en: ROTC stands for Reserve Officers' Training Corps.
It is a college-based program that provides military training and leadership education to students who may later serve in the armed forces.
ceb: Ang ROTC nagpasabot og Reserve Officers' Training Corps.
Kini usa ka programa sa kolehiyo nga naghatag og military training ug leadership education sa mga estudyante nga mahimong mosilbi sa armed forces sa umaabot.

en: Yes, course shifting is allowed at BukSU, especially after finishing your first year course.
However, please note that usually only minor subjects are credited.
This means you will not need to retake those specific classes in your new program.
It is rare for major subjects to be credited, so it is recommended to check with the Registrar’s Office for more details.

Please also keep in mind that for certain specific courses, you are not permitted to shift during the second semester. In these cases, you must complete your entire first year in your current program before you are eligible to transfer to a different course.
ceb: Oo, pwede ra mag-shift og course sa BukSU, labi na kung first year pa.
Apan palihog timan-i nga kasagaran mga minor subjects ra ang ma-credit.
Pasabot niini nga dili na nimo kinahanglan kuhaon balik ang mga maong subject sa imong bag-ong kurso.
Talagsa ra kaayo nga ma-credit ang major subjects, mao nga mas maayo mangutana ka sa Registrar’s Office para sa mas klaro nga detalye.

Palihog hinumdumi usab nga para sa pipila ka espesipikong kurso, dili tugotan ang pag-shift sa ikaduhang semester. Sa ing-ani nga mga kaso, kinahanglan nimo tapuson ang tibuok first year sa imong current nga programa usa ka pa mahimong eligible nga mobalhin sa lain nga kurso.

en: Shifting courses in the third year is possible, but it may delay graduation.
ceb: Pwede mag-shift pero basin ma-delay ang graduation.

en: Not all courses require an internship; it depends on the curriculum.
ceb: Dili tanan kurso naay internship, depende sa curriculum.

en: On-the-job training (OJT) provides students with real-world work experience related to their course.
ceb: Ang on-the-job training (OJT) naghatag ug real-world nga work experience nga konektado sa imong kurso.

en: Students who wish to shift to another program must meet the grade requirements of the new college.
They must also obtain approval from both the current department and the receiving department.
Shifting is usually processed during the enrollment period for the next semester.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante nga gusto mag shift sa laing kurso kinahanglan makab ot sa grade requirements sa bag ong kolehiyo.
Kinahanglan usab makakuha og approval gikan sa karaan ug bag ong departamento.
Kasagaran ginaproseso ang shifting sa panahon sa enrollment sa sunod nga semester.
